{{Top|leg}}
'''Vergesso Control''' monitored all [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traffic at the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] in the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]], as well as its defenses. It was situated in the middle of the [[Base Operations Center]] level of the Base.

Vergesso Control checked approaching ships against [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] files and assigned appropriate [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]]. Ships slaved their controls over to Vergesso Control for safe landing, though many [[Captain/Legends|captains]] refused to do so, incurring the base's manual landing fee and risking damages.
